gloss: to break in; to force one's way in

definitions.gloss: to break in; to force one's way in; to burst in
definitions.explanation: Used for unauthorized entry, often with criminal or aggressive implications. Intransitive verb formed from 押す (to push) + 入る (to enter).

examples.japanese: {強盗|ごうとう}が{家|いえ}に{押|お}し{入|い}った。
examples.english: A robber broke into the house.

examples.japanese: {不審者|ふしんしゃ}が{店|みせ}に{押|お}し{入|い}り、{現金|げんきん}を{奪|うば}った。
examples.english: A suspicious person broke into the store and stole cash.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}が{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}の{部屋|へや}に{押|お}し{入|い}った。
examples.english: The police forced their way into the suspect's room.

notes:
{押|お}し{入|い}る is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) formed from {押|お}す (to push) + {入|い}る (to enter).

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
・[place]に{押|お}し{入|い}る - to break into [place]

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{家|いえ}に{押|お}し{入|い}る - to break into a house
・{店|みせ}に{押|お}し{入|い}る - to break into a store
・{強盗|ごうとう}が{押|お}し{入|い}る - a robber breaks in

RELATED:
・{押|お}し{込|こ}む - to force into
・{侵入|しんにゅう}する - to intrude (more formal)
